name: Survey Designer
summary: Designs a short, unbiased survey for a research goal, with question rationale and analysis plan.
description: Drafts survey questions mapped to the research goal, flags leading or double-barreled wording, and proposes how each answer will be analyzed.
problems: I want feedback from many users quickly
I need to measure satisfaction or demand

inputs.label: Audience
inputs.example: Trial users who signed up in the last 30 days

outputs.label: Survey
outputs.description: Questions with type, options and rationale.

outputs.label: Analysis plan
outputs.description: How each question will be analyzed.

steps.name: Draft survey
steps.responsibility: Write questions mapped to the research goal.

steps.name: Bias review
steps.responsibility: Flag leading, loaded or double-barreled questions and rewrite them.

criteria.description: Question count does not exceed the maximum.
